mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary policy, boosting equity markets.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment signals economic weakness, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns don't decline when UNRATE exceeds 6.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth with rising unemployment indicates labor market contradictions, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: No negative returns despite conflicting labor signals.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts in late-cycle expansion signal strong demand, boosting returns.
failure_condition: Returns don't rise with high housing starts in late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment indicates a strong economy, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Low UNRATE doesn't predict positive 5-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals supply issues, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns don't fall when INDPRO is below 110.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales and housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns with high demand indicators.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate in tightening cycle predicts negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns don't fall when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5%.
